title: Suggest rep increases
highlights: Settings → Device & timers → Progression: turn on Suggest rep increases to get optional Library default bumps after strong sessions.
When you're ready, a Ready to level up? card appears on Today after you finish a workout—tap to review exercises and accept +2 reps or seconds.
Snooze for 14 days or ignore per exercise; ignored exercises can be re-enabled in Settings or Library.

title: Health Connect import fix
highlights: Importing a walk or cardio session from Health Connect no longer writes a duplicate session back to Health Connect.
That duplicate could inflate daily step totals when your watch and phone both report activity—ME now only mirrors sessions it tracked itself (GPS or timer).
If you already imported walks before this fix, you may need to remove duplicate My Exercise sessions in Health Connect for today's step count to match.

title: Daily health on Progress
highlights: Active calories chart now shows your full Health Connect daily total—strength workouts, cardio, and everyday activity—not only logged cardio sessions.
New average heart rate chart uses the same 14-day daily totals as steps.
Health Connect daily metrics refresh when you open the app or return from the background, not only when you visit Progress.
